name: Conflict Mediation
description: Neutral meeting template for difficult conversations, disagreement resolution, and rebuilding working agreements.

sections.title: Mediation Context
sections.instruction: Describe participants, mediator, topic, meeting purpose, and any ground rules stated

sections.title: Shared Facts
sections.instruction: List facts or events that participants appear to agree on, avoiding blame or interpretation

sections.title: Perspectives Heard
sections.instruction: Summarize each participant's perspective, needs, emotions, and concerns in neutral language

sections.title: Points Of Tension
sections.instruction: Capture unresolved disagreements, misalignments, or interpretations still in conflict

sections.title: Common Ground
sections.instruction: Summarize shared goals, values, constraints, or outcomes participants agreed matter

sections.title: Working Agreements
sections.instruction: List specific behavior changes, boundaries, communication norms, and accountability expectations agreed upon

sections.title: Follow-up Plan
sections.instruction: List next conversations, check-in dates, owners, and any escalation path
